title: Semantic Mismapping in Generalized Category Discovery: Evaluation and Mitigation
abstract: arXiv:2610.39356v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Generalized Category Discovery (GCD) aims to perform old-category recognition and novel-category discovery in the same unlabeled set. Early methods address both objectives through clustering and evaluate the exchangeable predicted indices with global Hungarian (GH) matching. Recent methods adopt trainable parametric heads, using supervision for old-category recognition and discovery-oriented objectives for new categories. In this way, the output space becomes partially exchangeable: old indices are semantically anchored, while new indices remain exchangeable. However, these methods still apply global matching, which can reassign anchored old indices to other categories and hide some prediction errors. Empirically, we are surprised to observe that this reassignment can induce an overestimation of new-category accuracy by up to 25.63 points. translated_title: 广义类别发现中的语义错配：评估与缓解
translated_abstract: arXiv:2610.39356v1 公告类型：交叉 摘要：广义类别发现（GCD）旨在同一个无标签集合中同时完成旧类别识别与新类别发现。早期方法通过聚类来处理这两个目标，并采用全局匈牙利（GH）匹配来评估完全可交换的预测索引。近期方法则采用可训练的参数化头部，利用监督信号完成旧类别识别，并使用面向发现的目标函数来处理新类别。这样一来，输出空间变为部分可交换：旧索引在语义上被锚定，而新索引仍然保持可交换性。然而，这些方法仍然使用全局匹配，这可能会将已锚定的旧索引重新分配到其他类别，并掩盖某些预测错误。在实证研究中，我们惊讶地发现这种重新分配会导致新类别准确率被高估多达25.63个百分点。我们将这一现象命名为“语义错配”，并进一步推导出一个置换环条件……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 本文揭示了广义类别发现评估中的“语义错配”现象——全局匈牙利匹配会将已锚定的旧类别索引重新分配，从而高估新类别准确率多达25.63个百分点，并提出置换环条件来评估与缓解这一问题。
en_tdlr: This paper identifies "semantic mismapping" in Generalized Category Discovery evaluation, where global Hungarian matching reassigns semantically anchored old-category indices—overestimating new-category accuracy by up to 25.63 points—and derives a permutation-cycle condition for evaluation and mitigation.
